title: The garage, iv
venue: Arthur's site (newspaper cadence: six dailies + a Sunday)
logline: Thursday. The sill. One jar arrives — brushes. The window onto the alley. The first Rain-Sunday composition, found on a Thursday with no rain.

panels.composition: The casement window over the drafting table, onto the alley. Dry. WOOD setting a jar of brushes on the sill.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man setting a jar of brushes on a casement window's sill above a drafting table, an alley outside, dry daylight

panels.composition: The jar. The sill. The window. The composition.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a single jar of brushes on a windowsill with an alley beyond the glass, composed carefully
image.notes: The sill of the Rain Sundays (2005–2020) begins with one jar. Three by 2013.

panels.composition: Wood stepping back and looking at it longer than a jar deserves. The dog on the concrete, unimpressed.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man standing back and looking at a jar on a windowsill with unusual attention while a small dog lies unimpressed on the floor, no words

panels.composition: Wood at the table, drawing the jar. The dog asleep. Outside: the first drop on the glass.
